parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

💡
alter[ɔ:ltər]v.
To alter something means to make a small change to it.
→ I altered the color of my nails to match my hair.
💡
aside[əsaid]adv.
If someone stands aside, they are on or to one side.
→ The man stood aside and opened the door for me.
💡
autumn[ɔ:təm]n.
Autumn is the season of the year between summer and winter.
→ I love when the leaves fall in autumn because I can play in them.
💡
blend[blend]v.
To blend is to mix two or more things together so that they become one thing.
→ My wife blended together all of the ingredients to make a delicious stew.
💡
collapse[kəlæps]v.
To collapse is to fall down suddenly.
→ The tree collapsed right in front of our house.
💡
crush[krʌʃ]v.
To crush something is to press it together so its shape is destroyed.
→ Selena’s new car was crushed when something fell on top of it.
💡
curve[kə:rv]v.
To curve is to move in a line that bends and does not go straight.
→ The road curves to the left and to the right.
💡
disgusting[disgʌstiŋ]adj.
If something is disgusting, it is very unpleasant.
→ After running all day, Greg’s feet had a disgusting odor.
💡
drain[drein]n.
A drain is a pipe that carries away water from a building, such as in a kitchen.
→ The water in the sink goes down the drain as you wash your hands.
💡
embrace[imbreis]v.
To embrace is to hug.
→ When they saw each other again, the happy couple embraced.
💡
envy[envi]v.
To envy someone is to wish that you had something that they have.
→ Sally envied the happy couple.
💡
fireworks[faiərwə:rks]n.
Fireworks are objects that create colored lights when they are lit.
→ The display of fireworks was so beautiful.
💡
flour[flauər]n.
Flour is a powder made from plants that is used to make foods like bread.
→ I wanted to bake a pie, but I needed flour.
💡
fuse[fju:z]n.
A fuse is a string that you light on fireworks to make them explode.
→ The boy lit the fuse on the rocket and waited for it to burst in the sky.
💡
ginger[dʒindʒər]n.
Ginger is a spice from the root of a plant. It tastes spicy and sweet.
→ Ginger is a common ingredient in many dishes from India.
💡
jealous[dʒeləs]adj.
If you are jealous, you think someone might take something from you.
→ Miriam was jealous because Sue was paying too much attention to Jim.
💡
paste[peist]n.
A paste is a thick and smooth substance.
→ My son needed some paste for a school project.
💡
receipt[risi:t]n.
A receipt is a paper that proves that something was received or bought.
→ After looking at my receipt, I realized that I had spent too much money.
💡
wipe[waip]v.
To wipe something is to slide a piece of cloth over it to clean it.
→ She wiped the dust from the windows.
💡
wire[waiər]n.
A wire is a thin string made out of metal.
→ The wires were connected to towers that brought electricity to the city.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Circle two words that are related in each group.

questions.content: a. collapse  b. alter  c. wire  d. crush
questions.explanation: collapse (sụp đổ) và crush (đè nát) đều liên quan đến sự phá hủy hình dạng.

questions.content: a. disgusting  b. envy  c. jealous  d. wipe
questions.explanation: envy (ghen tị) và jealous (đố kị) có nghĩa tương đồng nhau.

questions.content: a. ginger  b. autumn  c. receipt  d. flour
questions.explanation: ginger (gừng) và flour (bột mì) đều là nguyên liệu nấu ăn.

questions.content: a. fuse  b. curve  c. fireworks  d. drain
questions.explanation: fuse (ngòi nổ) và fireworks (pháo hoa) có liên hệ mật thiết với nhau.

questions.content: a. aside  b. paste  c. blend  d. embrace
questions.explanation: paste (hỗn hợp nhão/hồ) và blend (trộn lẫn) liên quan đến việc pha trộn chất.

sections.content: Exercise 2: Write a word that is similar in meaning to the underlined part.

questions.content:
1. The mixture was a funny color and looked very unpleasant. [ 6 ]

2. After the house fell down suddenly, the family built a new home somewhere else. [ 7 ]

3. When the boy spilled his milk, his mother rubbed a cloth over it. [ 8 ]

4. The bird moved in a line that was not straight through the sky. [ 9 ]

5. The mother hugged the crying child to make her feel better. [ 10 ]

6. The farmer’s food was usually ready in the season before winter. [ 11 ]

7. The metal string was in between the two poles. [ 12 ]

8. She made small changes to her drawing before giving it to her friend. [ 13 ]

9. The pipe that carries water away was clogged with hair. [ 14 ]

10. I asked the taxi driver to give me a document that proved how much I paid. [ 15 ]
questions.explanation: very unpleasant đồng nghĩa với disgusting (kinh tởm, khó chịu).
fell down suddenly đồng nghĩa với collapsed (sụp đổ).
rubbed a cloth over đồng nghĩa với wiped (lau chùi).
moved in a line that was not straight đồng nghĩa với curved (bay lượn cong).
hugged đồng nghĩa với embraced (ôm).
season before winter là autumn (mùa thu).
metal string là wire (dây kim loại).
made small changes to đồng nghĩa với altered (thay đổi, chỉnh sửa).
pipe that carries water away là drain (ống thoát nước).
document that proved how much I paid là receipt (biên lai, hóa đơn).

sections.title: Exercise 3: Choose the word that is a better fit for each blank.

questions.content: 1. The roof of the old house hadn’t been ________ since it was built. Since it wasn’t cared for, it eventually ________. (altered / collapsed)
questions.explanation: Mái nhà không được sửa đổi/tu sửa (altered) nên cuối cùng đã sụp đổ (collapsed).

questions.content: 2. The recipe says to use two tablespoons of fresh ________. Then ________ all of the ingredients together and put it over the meat. (ginger / blend)
questions.explanation: Dùng hai thìa gừng (ginger) tươi rồi trộn (blend) tất cả nguyên liệu lại.

questions.content: 3. Last ________, my neighbor’s parents gave him a toy rocket to put together. I ________ him because I’ve always wanted one for myself. (autumn / envied)
questions.explanation: Mùa thu (autumn) năm ngoái, tôi đã rất ghen tị (envied) với cậu hàng xóm.

questions.content: 4. The family stood ________ as the father tried to fix the car. He was sure that he just needed to fix the ________ on it. (aside / wires)
questions.explanation: Gia đình đứng sang một bên (aside) khi người bố sửa dây điện (wires).

questions.content: 5. On my way home, I accidentally ________ the carton of eggs. The store let me exchange them since I had my ________. (crushed / receipt)
questions.explanation: Vô tình làm dập nát (crushed) hộp trứng nhưng được đổi lại nhờ có hóa đơn (receipt).

questions.content: 6. At the end of the festival, there were supposed to be ________. However, they didn’t work because something had damaged the ________. (fireworks / fuse)
questions.explanation: Đáng lẽ có pháo hoa (fireworks) nhưng không nổ vì hỏng ngòi nổ (fuse).

questions.content: 7. Annie bought a type of paint that was a thick ________. It was easy to use, and when she was done, she ________ it up with an old cloth. (paste / wiped)
questions.explanation: Loại sơn dạng hỗn hợp đặc (paste) và cô lau sạch (wiped) bằng khăn cũ.

questions.content: 8. The player hit the ball and it ________ through the field without anybody touching it. As a result, the team won the game and ________ each other in happiness. (curved / embraced)
questions.explanation: Quả bóng bay vòng cung (curved) qua sân, cả đội thắng cuộc và ôm (embraced) nhau.

questions.content: 9. The girl wasn’t ________ of her brother’s new friend. All they did was talk about ________ things like frogs and snakes. (jealous / disgusting)
questions.explanation: Cô bé không ghen tị (jealous) vì họ chỉ nói về những thứ kinh tởm (disgusting).

questions.content: 10. Megan didn’t use enough ________ when making pancakes. As a result, she poured the mixture down the ________ and tried again. (flour / drain)
questions.explanation: Không dùng đủ bột mì (flour) nên phải đổ hỗn hợp xuống ống thoát nước (drain).

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
Everyone is Special

When I was young, everything that went wrong in my house seemed to be my fault. Once, my brothers tried to make cookies. They blended flour and ginger and made a disgusting paste. Then they tried to wash it down the drain, but it got all over the floor. Later, my brothers said that I did it and I had to wipe it up.

I worried that my parents liked them more than me. One autumn day, I was sure I would make my parents proud. I bought a model rocket. After I put it together, I invited everybody to watch it. I wanted my brothers to envy my technical knowledge. I lit the fuse, but nothing happened.

“Looks like your fireworks don’t work. I hope you kept the receipt so you can return them,” my brother said.

“It’s not fireworks!” I screamed. They were making fun of me again.

I didn’t know what went wrong. I hadn’t altered anything. I quickly moved the wires on the bottom, hoping that would help. Suddenly, the rocket flew up. We stood aside as it curved through the lawn and ran straight into the mailbox. Then the mailbox collapsed. The rocket was crushed.

Embarrassed, I ran inside and hid. A few minutes later, my mom asked, “Are you OK?”

“I just wanted them to be jealous of me for once. Now I see why you and Dad don’t love me as much as them,” I said.

“That’s not true!” said my mom. “See my fingers . . . each one is different. You kids are like my fingers: all are different, but I love them all the same.”

I embraced her. Now I know that my parents love me just as much as my brothers.
parts.translation:
Mỗi Người Đều Đặc Biệt

Khi tôi còn nhỏ, mọi chuyện rắc rối xảy ra trong nhà dường như đều là lỗi của tôi. Có một lần, các anh trai tôi thử làm bánh quy. Họ trộn bột mì và gừng tạo thành một hỗn hợp nhão kinh khủng. Sau đó họ cố xả nó xuống ống thoát nước, nhưng nó lại tràn ra khắp sàn nhà. Sau đó, các anh tôi bảo rằng tôi đã làm chuyện đó và tôi phải lau sạch sẽ.

Tôi lo rằng bố mẹ yêu quý các anh hơn tôi. Vào một ngày mùa thu, tôi chắc mẩm rằng mình sẽ làm bố mẹ tự hào. Tôi mua một chiếc tên lửa mô hình. Sau khi lắp ráp xong, tôi mời cả nhà ra xem. Tôi muốn các anh phải ngưỡng mộ/ghen tị với kiến thức kỹ thuật của mình. Tôi châm ngòi nổ, nhưng chẳng có gì xảy ra.

“Có vẻ như pháo hoa của em không hoạt động rồi. Anh hy vọng em vẫn giữ biên lai để đem trả lại,” anh trai tôi nói.

“Đó không phải là pháo hoa!” tôi hét lên. Họ lại chế giễu tôi nữa rồi.

Tôi không biết chuyện gì đã trục trặc. Tôi đã không thay đổi bất cứ thứ gì. Tôi nhanh tay chỉnh lại mấy sợi dây kim loại ở phía dưới, hy vọng làm vậy sẽ giúp ích. Đột nhiên, chiếc tên lửa bay vọt lên. Chúng tôi đứng sang một bên khi nó bay vòng cung qua bãi cỏ rồi đâm sầm vào thùng thư. Thùng thư đổ sập xuống. Chiếc tên lửa bị nghiền nát.

Xấu hổ, tôi chạy vào trong nhà và trốn đi. Vài phút sau, mẹ tôi hỏi: “Con có sao không?”

“Con chỉ muốn các anh ghen tị với con một lần thôi. Giờ thì con đã hiểu tại sao bố mẹ không yêu con nhiều như yêu các anh,” tôi nói.

“Không phải vậy đâu!” mẹ tôi nói. “Hãy nhìn những ngón tay của mẹ này... mỗi ngón đều khác nhau. Các con cũng giống như những ngón tay của mẹ vậy: mỗi đứa đều khác biệt, nhưng mẹ yêu tất cả các con như nhau.”

Tôi ôm chầm lấy mẹ. Giờ thì tôi biết rằng bố mẹ cũng yêu thương tôi nhiều như yêu các anh trai mình.

sections.title: Part A: Mark each statement True or False.

questions.content: The brothers blended flour and ginger together when trying to make a disgusting paste.
questions.explanation: Các anh trai định làm bánh quy ('Once, my brothers tried to make cookies'), không phải cố tình tạo ra hỗn hợp kinh tởm -> Sai (False).

questions.content: The family stood aside on an autumn day to watch the girl launch her rocket.
questions.explanation: Trong bài viết: 'One autumn day... We stood aside as it curved through the lawn' -> Đúng (True).

questions.content: The model rocket worked after the fuse was altered.
questions.explanation: Tên lửa bay lên sau khi cô bé chỉnh lại dây điện ở dưới đáy ('I quickly moved the wires on the bottom... Suddenly, the rocket flew up.') -> Sai (False).

questions.content: The mailbox is crushed because the rocket curves into it.
questions.explanation: Thùng thư bị đổ sập ('the mailbox collapsed'), còn chiếc tên lửa mới bị nghiền nát ('The rocket was crushed') -> Sai (False).

questions.content: The girl wanted her brothers to be jealous of her.
questions.explanation: Trong bài viết: 'I just wanted them to be jealous of me for once.' -> Đúng (True).

questions.content: The mother embraces the girl and says she doesn’t love any of her children more than the others.
questions.explanation: Người mẹ nói yêu tất cả các con như nhau và hai mẹ con ôm nhau -> Đúng (True).

questions.content: All of the following happened when the brothers tried to cook EXCEPT ________.
options: they tried to put the paste down the drain
questions.explanation: Người kể chuyện phải lau dọn ('I had to wipe it up'), chứ không phải các anh trai.

questions.content: The girl thought that putting together the model rocket proved her ________.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2: 'I wanted my brothers to envy my technical knowledge.'

questions.content: Why does her brother say that he hopes she kept the receipt?
options: He wants to buy her a new rocket.
He wants her to save money.
He thinks she should return the rocket.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3: 'I hope you kept the receipt so you can return them.'

questions.content: The mother tells the girl that her children are like her fingers because ________.
options: they all are different but loved
questions.explanation: Đoạn 8: 'You kids are like my fingers: all are different, but I love them all the same.'
